Functions
find_bandstructure_pts
index_t* find_bandstructure_pts(
diverge_model_t* 
m,
index_t** 
indices,
index_t* 
n_indices
)

finds fine mesh points (as indices) that lie on the segments that define the irreducible path. Useful for, e.g., generation of the Hamiltonian (or self-energy) along the irreducible path, or outputting a susceptibility.  Written such that the runtime is O(nk * n_ibz_path). Requires a previous call to diverge_model_internals_common in order to prepare the momentum meshes.

Parameters
m
diverge_model_t*

the model to use (with bandstructure path defined in m->ibz_path and m->n_ibz_path)

indices
index_t**

pointer to result array that is allocated and filled with the indices that lie on the ibz path. indices refer to fine mesh.

n_indices
index_t*

pointer to length of result array

Returns

The number of points per segment in an array. both the returned array as well as the *indices array must be free'd manually.

Example

find_bandstructure_pts or find_bandstructure_pts_crs can be used as follows:

diverge_model_t* m;
// fill m with appropriate content
diverge_model_internals_common( m );
index_t* pts;
index_t n_pts;
index_t* n_per_segment = find_bandstructure_pts( m, &pts, &n_pts );
// do something with pts, n_pts, and n_per_segment.
free( pts );
free( n_per_segment );
